text:
maria: Heads-up — we need to open a quota + networking preflight for a pilot in eu-west4. Targeting a mix: 6x A100-80GB for Dedicated pilot and 12x L4 for burst/scale tests. Need Shared VPC host approval and external NAT capacity.
kevin: Do we have the host project already? which service project will request the accelerators?
maria: host project is proj-redwood-shared-vpc. Service project will be proj-cust-pilot-2025. I can make the IAM binding if infra approves.
anya: Important: request both "acceleratorTypes" quotas and "External IP addresses" + "Cloud NAT throughput". eu-west4 can be tight for L4.
kevin: Can you paste the minimal JSON payload you plan to submit to GCP support?
maria: Sure — saving here so approvers can eyeball: ```{
  "project": "proj-redwood-shared-vpc",
  "region": "europe-west4",
  "quotas": [
    {"metric":"NVIDIA_A100_80GB_ACCELERATORS","limit":6},
    {"metric":"NVIDIA_L4_ACCELERATORS","limit":12},
    {"metric":"EXTERNAL_ADDRESSES","limit":8},
    {"metric":"SNAT_CAPACITY_PER_VM","limit":2000}
  ],
  "justification": "Dedicated pilot for customer X; latency SLO tests and burst pool for hosted API"
}```
infra-bot: Support ticket created: #GCP-85521 — "eu-west4 accelerator + network preflight". ETA from GCP support ~48-72h. :robot_face:
kevin: Please ensure we request quota increase for both "accelerator quota" and the per-project per-region SSH ephemeral IP limit — we've hit that before during scale tests.
anya: Also add a request for a service account with Compute Admin and Network Admin in the host project so the provisioning CI can create instances in the service project.
maria: noted. I'll include: \n- SA: prod-gpu-provisioner@proj-redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\n- Roles: roles/compute.admin, roles/compute.networkAdmin\n- Request that the SA be allowed to use the reserved secondary ranges.
sam: Quick cost callout for billing: 6x A100-80GB reserved for 30 days + 12x L4 ephemeral burst — rough committed cost ~ $65k/mo if we 24/7 reserved. Can we start with preemptible for A100 for initial smoke?
billing: If you elect preemptible for pilot, we need to route charges to COGS-Pilot; confirm account code.
maria: For the pilot we want a mix: 4 preemptible A100 + 2 on-demand A100 minimum for reliability. I added that in the justification.
kevin: Network preflight question: do we need external IPs on the instances or will the host NAT suffice? Prefer: no external IPs, use private IP + Cloud NAT egress. Less quota pressure and simpler firewall.
anya: Agree — but Cloud NAT per-region throughput is limited. Ask GCP for SNAT scalability and potential recommendation for adding multiple NAT gateways in the host project.
maria: Added note to ticket: "Prefer private instances + NAT; request guidance on SNAT scale and suggestions for multiple NATs across zones."
infra-bot: GCP response (automated): "We can approve accelerator quota increases subject to billing verification and region capacity. Please confirm project billing and provide a contact for validation."
maria: Billing contact: julia@redwood.com. I've DM'd billing to confirm.
billing: Confirmed — account is active and billing contact available. We can greenlight quota from finance side.
kevin: Approve to escalate. I will add a short note for SRE to schedule a maintenance window for provisioning and testing (non-business hours).
anya: One more: request a list of alternative zones in eu-west (if zone resource constrained) — ask GCP to suggest fallback zones and whether we can request cross-zone capacity reservation.
maria: Done. I'll update the ticket and ping here when GCP responds with capacity availability. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
